sentences.en: The results revealed that frequency of luteal phase deficiency (LPD) and anovulation was significantly greater in the exercising women than that in the sedentary women.

sentences.en: Withdrawal bleeding after progestational challenge, along with normal PRL and TSH level, demonstrate amenorrhea caused by anovulation.

sentences.en: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is defined as a syndrome of ovarian hyperandrogenism and chronic anovulation.
sentences.vi: Hội chứng buồng trứng đa nang (PCOS) được định nghĩa là một hội chứng tăng sinh buồng trứng và rụng trứng mãn tính.
